subject: Priority: staffing accelerator request — Sr. Inference Engineer backfill
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.redwood@example.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Priority: staffing accelerator request — Sr. Inference Engineer backfill

Team,

We need authorization to open a priority backfill for the Senior Inference Engineer on infra/oncall (headcount was vacated last week). This is creating an immediate oncall capacity gap and blocking a planned Dedicated rollout for an existing customer. Proposed plan:

- Open a 1.0 FTE backfill (level: Senior) on an expedited cadence
- Condensed interview slate (one loop + take-home + hiring manager debrief) over a 7–10 day window
- Requesting panel: Lauren (hiring mgmt), Markus (infra), + two rotating interviewers from the inference team (Aditya and 1 more to be assigned)
- Timeline: aim to schedule first loop by 11/18; offer decision by 11/24 if candidate fits

I've attached the job spec and a condensed interview slate for review. Budget owner: Lauren — please confirm final compensation band and whether we can authorize a relocation stipend up to $15k if needed.

Asks:
1) Greenlight to open the backfill headcount and post the req to internal/external channels
2) Approval to use the condensed slate and to prioritize scheduling for top-fit candidates (30–45 min slots across PST/EST)
3) Marissa — can you engage AtlasCloud for an accelerated slate and check immediate availability?

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Job_Spec_Sr_Inference_Engineer.pdf, Interview_Slate_Condensed_v1.docx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.redwood@example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Priority: staffing accelerator request — Sr. Inference Engineer backfill

Hannah — thanks for the summary and for collapsing the slate. I support moving this through the accelerator path given the customer risk. A few quick points before I sign the greenlight:

- Compensation: confirm the band aligns to Senior IC6 range (I can approve at midpoint; if we need to go above midpoint I'll pull finance).
- Interview rubric: please add a 10-min scoring checkpoint for deployment judgement and cost/latency tradeoffs (we've seen regressions when that dimension is missed).
- Relocation: approve up to $10k now; can escalate to $15k with a brief business case (sends to finance).

Marissa — please share earliest candidate availability and confirm the primary recruiter owner for scheduling.

Once compensation band confirmed, Hannah — you have my provisional sign-off to post and engage external recruiter. Final OK after Marissa confirms salary range.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks — looping in AtlasCloud and pushing an early slate. I'm attaching one external candidate (Olivia Park) who fits the infra + latency optimization bar and can start interviews next week. Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 11/17 10:00–11:00 (HM + infra)
- Wed 11/18 13:00–14:00 (tech deep-dive)
- Thu 11/19 09:00–09:30 (take-home/signoff)

Notes on candidate:
- Olivia Park — strong LLM serving background, most recently at a scale-up (resume attached).
- Open to relocation; requested $12k stipend (falls within approved band if Lauren confirms midpoint or above).
- Has a short take-home ready (30–45 min) focused on cache/kv strategies; prefers coding interview earlier in the week.

Aditya — can you hold the interview slots and draft the updated rubric Lauren requested? Markus, please confirm you'll join the infra loop on Tue.

Marissa Cole
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference

From: AtlasCloud Recruiting <recruiting@atlascloud.com>

Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@gmail.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Priority: staffing accelerator request — Sr. Inference Engineer backfill

Hi Marissa / Hannah,

Olivia is available and confirmed the proposed window. She also provided the following constraints:
- Cannot take calls before 10:00 PST on weekdays (care responsibilities)
- Available for the condensed coding loop on Wed 11/18 afternoon PST
- Prefers virtual interviews; open to in-person for an onsite if the offer moves forward

We have signed consent to share the resume (attached) and can provide references upon request. Olivia indicated she prefers a single consolidated feedback meeting after the first loop so we can accelerate to offer if greenlit.

Thanks — we'll stand by to schedule once Lauren confirms the band.

— AtlasCloud Recruiting (priya@atlascloud.com)

Thanks all — Lauren: midpoint compensation approved (I confirmed with finance). Relocation stipend capped at $12k for this hire; escalate if candidate requests more.

Marissa/AtlasCloud — please schedule the condensed slate around the candidate constraints (avoid before 10:00 PST). Aditya/Markus — please treat Tue/Wed slots as tentative hold; we'll confirm final calendar invites once recruiter pushes through.

One operational ask: Aditya, please add the 10-min deployment judgement checkpoint to the rubric and include a 1–5 severity for cost-vs-latency tradeoffs. I'll run the debrief immediately after loop 1 to keep the decision window tight.

I'll post the final invite thread and include the Google Doc link for scorecards. Thanks team — moving to scheduling.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
